goal: Fix the merge-gate enforcement hole: a code PR could merge when only the #2838 advisory Documents-only status was present, with no Migration guarded merge authorization and no exact-head verdicts. Separate the advisory onto its own context name and add Migration guarded merge authorization to live required checks.
dispatcher: MiMo chat parent dispatch for issue #3505
prohibited_actions: Do not touch any migration or database object.
Do not weaken or delete any existing test assertion.
assumptions: The advisory context name change is the preferred fix per issue guidance (distinguish by separate context name).
Adding Migration guarded merge authorization to live required checks enforces the gate at GitHub merge time regardless of merge path.
CI Agent work contract requires an evidence pair because code files are changed.
stop_conditions: Stop if any existing test assertion must be weakened to make the new tests pass.
Stop on any gate refusal rather than weakening the gate.
Stop if the change needs a file outside allowed_paths.
